objective: Replace the cloud-container-only release assumption with a provider-neutral local-first Python execution stack while preserving existing accepted Cloudflare Container evidence as an optional provider.
preservedEvidence: existing Cloudflare Container CPython 3.14.8 provider implementation

migrationTargets.purpose: interactive practice, offline learning, fast local execution
optional stronger shared isolation or remote execution

codexOnlyIfNeeded: deep WASM runtime integration across many files
large browser E2E harness or worker lifecycle debugging
acceptance: core Python learner journey works without paid credentials
browser/local provider reports exact runtime identity
offline path is real where declared
optional container provider can be disabled without corrupting learner state
PYTHON04, PYTHON05 and PYTHON06 targeted regressions PASS
stopConditions: requires new OAuth consent or secret
browser/WASM cannot satisfy a required Python capability and local desktop provider also cannot
root cause requires architecture beyond the allowed provider boundary
nextAction: Chat performs provider inventory and selects/implements the smallest browser/WASM provider behind the existing facade. Do not invoke Codex until a deep integration blocker is proven.
